notes: «وجده، من قبل أمه أبو ذباب» is one link by rule 7 (the name Abu Dhubab), a co-transmitter with إياس; «عن جده» is a bare relation and the speaker of the saying (rule 6)
«وكان المعيقيب على خاتم النبي» is the narrator's comment inside the saying, not a route
placement of أبو ذباب (co-transmitter or next link) is the one reading the text leaves open; see fixes

fixes.reason: RWY places أبو ذباب in sequence after إياس, where the text writes him as co-transmitter with إياس before «عن جده».

evidence.quote: وجده، من قبل أمه أبو ذباب عن جده
